name: Imaging Report
query:
SELECT 
    r.patient AS "Patient:Data:150",
    r.patient_name AS "Patient Name:Data:200", 
    r.date AS "Date:Data:100", 

    COALESCE(S.oustside, r.practitioner)
        AS "Doctor:Link/Healthcare Practitioner:300", 
    r.section AS "Section:Data:200", 
    r.eximination AS "Examination:Data:200",
    CASE r.docstatus
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Open'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Completed'
    END AS "Status:Data:100",
    r.name AS "Radiology:Link/Radiology:200"

    

FROM 
    `tabRadiology` r

JOIN 
    `tabUser` u ON r.owner = u.name 

LEFT JOIN 
    `tabSales Invoice` S ON r.reff_invoice = S.name

WHERE
    r.date BETWEEN %(from)s AND %(to)s
    AND r.docstatus != 2
    AND (
        %(doctor)s IS NULL
        OR %(doctor)s = ''
        OR r.practitioner = %(doctor)s
    );
